A '''Human''' [[Gender/Legends|male]] with [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and light skin served onboard a [[Unidentified Consular-class cruiser (Noggox)|freighter]] owned by [[Noggox]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. He had a scar running across his face.<ref name="Strange Allies" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Annual">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' places the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. The battle takes place just prior to the ''Secret Missions'' series.</ref> he was at the controls along with a [[Unidentified Rodian (Noggox's freighter)|Rodian]] when the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was carrying [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brains]] to the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]]. When it was near [[Shipwrights' Trace/Legends|Shipwrights' Trace]], the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] was intercepted by a [[Unidentified Lucrehulk-class pirate ship|pirate ship]]. The ship lost two of the [[Engine/Legends|thrusters]] and the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] during the attack. The [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Dool Pundar]], got the freighter to surrender and sent [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s to secure it. The Human then joined the rest of the crew in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] as Pundar took the freighter. At the time, the man was wearing a blue uniform with brown epaulets and a breastplate, along with a bandolier and gloves. The crew was later safely recovered.<ref name="Strange Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Human appears in [[2011]]'s ''[[The Clone Wars: Strange Allies]]'', a comic tie-in to the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Secret Missions]]'' series.
